Nice place to escape busy city
Jan 2017 • Family
I came here sometimes for swimming only but it is really nice place for families with kids because they have a large garden and restaurants. Everytime when i came here, i feel like i was in a airy small town, it was very quiet and nice. If some ones have kids and looking for a place for kids on weekends, just come here and you can spend all day here with them before to start a new busy week.
